findings.claim: OC133-NOSEND-001 / P012: owner approval plus manifest/channel-lock state machine operationally controls public action using owner approval, no-send lock, channel locks, fresh G57/G58/G70 gates, deposit-ready metadata, and public-record readiness.
findings.failure_mode: The fresh review, critical/high count, deposit_ready_metadata, and public_record_present gates are injected only inside the finite-model rows; they are not bound as fields in the authoritative publish manifest, owner approval file, or public manifest. Every public-action case also expects REJECT_PUBLIC_ACTION, including the named owner-approved control where deposit_ready_metadata=false and public_record_present=false. An always-reject evaluator could pass, so the artifact proves lockout only, not a real owner-approved publication state machine.
findings.required_repair: Add the missing gates as structured, hash-bound fields or referenced gate artifacts in the release-control metadata; add an all-gates-open ACCEPT_PUBLIC_ACTION control; relabel the current owner-approved case as a deposit/public-record-not-ready reject; regenerate finite checks and the coverage matrix.

findings.claim: OC133_NO_SEND_PUBLIC_SURFACE_MANIFEST_v12 is the public-surface manifest for the no-send review bundle.
findings.failure_mode: The public inventories disagree: manifest.json lists the 16 payload files but omits manifest.json and checksums.txt, checksums.txt includes manifest.json plus those payload files but omits itself, and ro-crate-metadata.jsonld declares both manifest.json and checksums.txt as hasPart. Without an explicit self/checksum exception policy, public consumers cannot determine the authoritative release-critical file set.
findings.required_repair: Align manifest.json, checksums.txt, and ro-crate-metadata.jsonld with one explicit inventory policy; include checksums.txt in the manifest or declare a named nonrecursive exception; regenerate hashes and any finite-model public-surface checks.

findings.claim: finite_row_theorem_ref_total=21 and finite_row_theorem_ref_bound_total=21 establish theorem/reference binding for the finite rows.
findings.failure_mode: The counted finite_row_theorem_refs include Python evaluator functions and a JSON publish manifest path, not only Lean theorem references. This lets script hooks and governance files be counted under theorem-ref binding, overstating machine-checked theorem coverage despite machine_checked_subset_total=10.
findings.required_repair: Split Lean theorem refs, semantic evaluator refs, and governance refs into separate fields and totals; stop using lean_ref/theorem_ref wording for Python or JSON controls; recompute the counts and update dependent public metadata.
